question: ______ is a newsletter published by the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) and Equifax.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Microfinance Pulse.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)**

__
 
• An independent financial institution, the Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) supports the expansion of Micro, Small, and **Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)**, which make significant **contributions to the national economy** in terms of production, employment, and exports.
 
• SIDBI was established with the intention of addressing the** development and financial gaps** in the ecosystem of MSMEs and facilitating and strengthening the flow of credit to Micro, Small, and Medium-Sized Enterprises.
 
• The Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) is a **government-run financial institution**. It was established as a statutory body in **1990** by an act of the **Indian Parliament.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Functions of SIDBI**

 
• **​**It aims to become a single point of contact for** MSMEs' developmental and financial needs** in order to keep the institution a customer-friendly financial body and make them strong, vibrant, and globally competitive.
 
• Additionally, it aims to** increase shareholder **wealth via a cutting-edge technology platform.
 
• It contributes to the **growth and promotion** of the MSME sector.
 
• It is the primary organization in charge of the MSME **sector's development, promotion, and financing,** as well as the coordination of the functions of other organizations involved in similar endeavors.
